ownership_rule: Every sequential cell belongs to its explicitly instantiated fixed M1-M10 macro and bound complete final view. Original responsibilities in state-ownership-current396 apply to exactly identical instance/type/logical interface map; newSarbiterphysical implementation/drive/clock cells andstatebinding belong to s_port. UpperM11/M12 adds passive interconnect only. No hidden controller/queue/arbiter/clock/reset state.
